entries.appliesTo: West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission (Chancellor or designee)

sources.program: §18B-3D-8(c) — 'the West Virginia Micro-Credential Program is established within the West Virginia Higher Education Policy Commission. The Chancellor or their designee shall be responsible for developing and administering the Micro-Credential Program'

flags: AI is mentioned only once and permissively — §18B-3D-8(d)(4): 'Utilize digital, web-based, artificial intelligence-based, hands-on, or on-the-job micro-credentials as needed to meet workforce and market demands' — the bill imposes no AI-specific duty on anyone

the commission's mandatory program-development obligations (§18B-3D-8(c)(1)-(6): standards and procedures for micro-credential design, verification, records security, and institutional assistance) fit no listed duty key; noted here rather than inventing a duty
no penalty, enforcement, or private/education compliance provision anywhere in the text
arguably an education-adjacent bill, but it binds only a state agency (the commission), not schools/districts/curricula, so category is public-sector
